# Hi! I’m Julie Roy, DPT

#### Dry Needling Certified

#### LSVT Certified Clinician

Hi I’m Julie! I am the founder of Achieve Physical Therapy in Barrington. I am a physical therapist focused on helping people move better and without pain. Whether you are trying to prevent injury, recovering from orthopedic surgery, managing a neurologic condition, or dealing with jaw pain.

I earned my doctorate of physical therapy degree from Carroll University and have higher level certifications in [Dry Needling](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/treatment-techniques/trigger-point-dry-needling), as well as [LSVT (Lee Silverman Voice Treatment) BIG](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/treatment-techniques/neurologic-physical-therapy); a specialized program designed to enhance movement in individuals with Parkinson’s Disease. I enjoy treating post-surgical orthopedic patients, as well as management of [temporomandibular joint (TMJ)](https://www.achieveptwellness.com/treatment-techniques/tmd-tmj), to alleviate pain and restore function of the jaw.

I am on my way to becoming a certified Pilates instructor through the National Pilates Certification Program, integrating Pilates into my therapeutic approach to enhance strength, flexibility, and overall WELLNESS.

My appoach is holistic and patient-centered, no rushed appointments - I will work with you one-on-one to set realistic goals and help you ACHIEVE them.

I live in the Village of Barrington with my husband Nick, our two boys; Casey and Riley, and our pup Bansi. We love exploring our town - trying new restaurants, seeing live music, and being active outside!
